name: Gearboxes and gear trains
summary: Gearboxes and gear trains that trade speed for torque, from tiny plastic gears to vehicle transmissions.
uses: Slow, strong drives for winches, pumps and grinders
Gearing a slow wind or water rotor up to a generator
identify: Cordless drills (planetary), mixers, garage door openers, wiper motors (worm), mobility scooters, washing machines and vehicle differentials. Worm gears hold their load when stopped; spur and planetary gears don’t.
test: Turn the input by hand: it should feel smooth, with little play and no grinding or missing teeth.
